product.name: Regular Fit Easy-iron Shirt
product.description: Regular-fit shirt in woven fabric with an easy-iron finish and a comfortable, classic silhouette. Turn-down collar, buttons without placket, and a yoke at back. Long sleeves with sleeve placket, link button, and adjustable cuffs with buttons. Rounded hem.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.
